notes.title: The demo release has been postponed for a few months
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694523/b622a81ab15623253a5cf9aff330f90d89fa4c37.png[/img]

Hi there. What happened? I messed up with my SSD with the project before making a backup. Data recovery specialists can't help so far. So my best approach now is to redo the Demo project, some coding, levels, and so on. But I don't need to do it from scratch. There why.

[h2]Backstory[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694523/681e842c813805c061a2f684f6297893db60e4e6.png[/img]

Total Gravity started as first my real try to make a playable game in the summer of 2021. You can still play this boring version on [url=https://oleksiykobozev.itch.io/total-gravity]Itch.io[/url].

As you can see it lacked good gameplay feedback, robust in control and progression in addition to terrible visuals, missing sounds, and so on. After receiving feedback from friends, I decided to develop this prototype into a mobile game.

At the end of 2021, I was even able to publish it on the App Store (the game is currently unavailable) and make several updates based on analytics and feedback. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694523/7c0981816a3117252f06093d4fa9c9fac4dd9e91.jpg[/img]

[b]Watch iOS version [url=https://fb.watch/q8tsO6pY8e/]Video teaser[/url][/b] 

Unfortunately, analytics showed that to make a profit after buying advertising for the game, I need to add an incredible amount of advertising and a "paywall". And that's not why I love games. [b]That was the last time when I did a backup properly.[/b]

While I was thinking about how to improve the game, on February 24, 2022, a [b]t@rrorist state[/b] launched a full-scale military invasion in addition to an already ongoing hybrid war. Games have become irrelevant.

I'm got lucky. My family is safe. So far I can continue to do what I can do best. In the autumn of 2023, I decided to make my dream about the game keep going. My next step was to redo Total Gravity in the Desktop game. I am almost done Demo. This is what it looked like in December of 2023. 
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@totalgravity.game/video/7298859084550278406]Main gameplay[/url] 
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@totalgravity.game/video/7309751514984090886?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7339535723089085958]Hub location[/url]

But as I wrote previously -- I messed up project files. 

[h2]What will happen next?[/h2]
I've already started to redo the demo. It's a good opportunity for "code refactoring". [b]Add Total Gravity to Wishlist[/b] so don't miss the demo and full game release. Best regards.
